calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school was Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was GGUSD Spring Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess ran March 16 through March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of GGUSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school was Wednesday, May 27, 2026.
